in_telugu.name: రిజుల్

in_marathi.name: Rijul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rijul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rijul is a Hindu name that means 'Soft Earth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rijuksh', which means 'Soft Earth'.
